description: This file is a shell script named process_monitor_atom.sh. It functions as a monitoring and self-healing script for a device running on an Atom CPU. The script performs various system health checks, restarts failed services such as WiFi, WebPA, harvester, and others, monitors hardware interfaces, logs system status, and manages network configurations. It includes logic to detect process crashes, hardware issues, and interface failures, and attempts to recover the system autonomously.

methods.name: restart_wifi
methods.description: Restarts the WiFi interface and associated processes, including checks for fast down scripts, apdown, and re-initialization of WiFi interfaces.

methods.name: Zombie_check
methods.description: Checks for zombie processes in the system and logs their details.
